milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the fire beacon and face it to confirm visual observation. Fire is at spawn-relative (5,3,5) and (8,3,5) on netherrack columns. Target set to (6,3,5) as the midpoint of the two fire blocks on the front face, with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 to model 'player can see the fire'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the smooth red sandstone slab roof and look toward it. The slab roof spans (5,4,5) to (8,4,8), so target is the center at (6,4,6). Max_distance=16 allows detection from nearby, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the roof.

Uses inventory_has because mining red sandstone with a pickaxe drops the red_sandstone item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no red_sandstone, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because mining cyan terracotta with a pickaxe drops the cyan_terracotta item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no cyan_terracotta, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.
